payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over possible jump lengths (1 to 25) and for each starting platform, check if platforms exist at multiples of that length (i, 2i, 3i, 4i) by checking membership in list of indices.
payload.rationale: The rule assigned search_backtracking due to weak supervision; solution is a simple brute-force existence check over jump lengths and start indices using list membership, not actual recursion/state exploration. Candidate families are complete_search but this is not backtracking. Hence mismatch.
